ycltf.full_description:
ISITIBA ESIQHUBA UKUFA

Nakuba phakathi kwezintaba-mlilo, Ukuphila Kuthola Indlela.

Yini uma isibonakaliso esibaluleke kakhulu sokuphila singeke sibe yindawo yokuzinikela eyenziwe ngabantu, kodwa siyisitshalo esiphilayo esi refused ukuxolisa?

Ucabanga ngedolobha elishalile ilizwi layo. Izindlu zivale, izitezi zifihle ngezansi kwezintaba-mlilo, futhi izicubu zempilo yabantu zibonakala zifihle ngokuzinikela. Kodwa-ke, esimisweni salesi sifunda esilahlekile, isihlahla esimangalisayo siqhubeka siphila.

Izintaba-mlilo azikho nje ukubheka umhlaba. Zifinyelela ezindlini ezibomvu, zithatha izindlu ezibomvu, zihamba phakathi kwezintaba ezihlukanisiwe, ziguqula ukufa ibe yisimo sokuxhumana. Izintaba-mlilo zikhula ziye ezulu, zithwala izimbali eziluhlaza eziluhlaza ngezansi kwelanga eliluhlaza eliphula amazulu.

Le ncwadi ingaphezu kweqiniso elizwakalayo lomuntu.

Isihlahla sibonisa wonke umuntu odlulele ezimpilweni ezinzima ngaphandle kokushiya izimpi zokuqala ukuchaza ikusasa labo. Sikhuluma ngalabo abalahlekile konke, kodwa bathola amandla okuqhubeka nokuphila. Kulabo abalahlekile ubomi, kodwa abavumeleni inhliziyo yabo ukuba ibe mnyama. Kulabo abaqondayo ukuthi ukuqhubeka nokuphila akuyona nje ukuhlala ubomi—ibonisa ukuzola, ukuxhumana, kanye nethuba lokuvuselela ubudlelwane nomphakathi ngemuva kokuhlukaniswa nokulahleka.

Izintaba-mlilo zibonisa ukumelana: amandla abonakalayo agcina sihamba ndawonye lapho konke okusendaweni yethu kushiya. Izintaba-mlilo zibonisa ukuxolisa, ukuxhumana, kanye nethuba lokuvuselela ubudlelwane nomphakathi ngemuva kokuhlukaniswa nokulahleka.

I-canopy eluhlaza igunya lokuthi ukulahleka akudingeki kube yisigaba sokugcina. Izilwane ezinyukayo ezingeni elivulekile zisikhumbuza ukuthi ubuzwe nokubuyiselwa kungabuyela, ngisho nasesikhathini esimnyama kakhulu.

Nokukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ngaphezu kwezintaba-mlilo kunikeza umlayezo ohlanzekile kodwa onamandla: ikusasa alichazwanga yilokho okulahlekile, kodwa yilokho okusekho okunekhono lokukhula.

Le misebenzi yobuciko ikhuluma nganoma ubani obhekene nesigaba esinzima empilweni, noma ubani ophinde wakhiwa ngemuva kokulahleka, noma ubani okholelwa ukuthi ithemba alikho ukunganeliseki, kodwa amandla okuqhubeka nakuba.

Ingxenye ebalulekile yegumbi lokuphumula, iofisi, ithala, istudio yokudala, noma iyiphi indawo lapho ukumelana, ukuvuselelwa, nokukhuthaza kudinga indawo. Ingaba nesipho esicabangayo somuntu oqala isiqephu esitsha, obhekana nezinkinga, noma othola ubuhlakani bokuba phezulu futhi.

I-THE LIGHT WE LEAVE EACH OTHER iyisipho sokuzinikela komuntu siqu esiyingqayizivele - i-invisible inheritance of kindness, knowledge, love, courage, and hope that passes from one generation to the next.

Engxenyeni eyinhloko yesakhiwo, i-lampion yegolide endulo ihamba kusuka esinye isiqephu sezandla siye kwenye. Engxenyeni ephakathi, imilenze yeminyaka nezinhlobo ezahlukene zihlangana ngesikhathi sokuxhumana. Abakhulu babonisa ubuhlakani nolwazi lwalabo abafika phambi kwethu. Izizukulwane ezincane zibonisa isiqinisekiso sokuthi yini ezayo. Ukukhanya okushisayo okukhazimulayo kanye ne-golden horizon ephakathi nendawo kuqinisa amagama endawo. Zibonisa ukungaqiniseki kwempilo, izimpi esibhekana nazo, kanye nokwenzeka kwesikhathi esikhanyayo lapho sikhetha ukuqhubeka sihlala ndawonye. Ukukhanya okushisayo okukhazimulayo kobuso nokufinyelela ezandlani kuguqula isibonakaliso esilula sibe yisona esijwayelekile: ukukholelwa ukuthi akukho msebenzi wothando olukhulu ongeke ulahlekile.

Le misebenzi imemezela ukucabanga komuntu siqu:

Ubani owaletha ukukhanya empilweni yakho lapho ufuna kakhulu? Ubani ozoba nomzila okhanyayo ngenxa yento okhetha ukuyinika namhlanje?

Umlayezo wayo ukhona kuwo wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ubudala, isizwe, ubuciko, noma isizinda. Sithole konke okuthile kwabanye, futhi sithole konke okunengqondo okuzosidlulisela.
